sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your style with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich emerald green dial, delicate stone accents, and a distinctive open-oval link chain strap. The deep green dial beautifully contrasts with the polished golden finish, creating a sophisticated vintage-inspired look.
Its petite round dial and artistic oval-link bracelet embellished with matching green crystal studs give it a refined, jewellery-like appearance, making it perfect for women who prefer a classic yet stylish timepiece. Easy to pair with both ethnic and western outfits, this watch adds a graceful touch to any look.
Product Highlights
✨ Vintage-inspired bracelet watch
💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
💚 Elegant deep emerald green dial
💎 Oval link chain embedded with green stone accents
🔗 Delicate adjustable chain extension
⌚ Quartz movement
✨ Jewellery-inspired statement bracelet design
👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
🎁 Ideal gifting option for women
✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
Office wear, college, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings, and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat, and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
